auditMdConditionalCandidate retains each original raw diagnostic result/counter/finding and reports all-fixture totals separately. Any assertion exception becomes FAIL_COMPONENT_SET with requiredComponentsMissing=1 and other counters null, not silently zero.

It intentionally relies on the host to authenticate central issuer/run/artifact identity first. Existing exactRasterFor uses acceptedRasterFor with requireReceiptDeclaredCoverage=true; direct fabricated metadata must not be supplied to this binder.
